_comment: Copy this to turn.json to switch online play back on.
A TURN server is a relay. With one, the only address either player
ever learns is the relay's, which is the whole point. Without one,
net-core.js refuses to connect rather than quietly falling back to a
direct connection and handing out addresses.
Two free ways to get one, both needing an account, neither of which
Cloudflare Realtime TURN. 1,000 GB free, wants a card on file.
Open Relay by Metered. 20 GB a month free, wants a signup, no card
